			),
			OR(
				'dim_plant_hierarchy'[region_desc] IN {"OSM Region Europe",
					"Region Other Business"},
				('dim_plant_hierarchy'[region_desc], 'dim_plant_hierarchy'[area_desc]) IN {("OMN Region Europe", "OMN REU East Europe"),
					("OMN Region Europe", "OMN REU Middle East & Africa"),
					("OMN Region Europe", "OMN REU West Europe"),
					("OMN Region Europe", "OMN REU Central & North Europe")}
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_plant_hierarchy'[plant_cod],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			__DS0FilterTable4,
			"Actual_KPIs_Switch", '_Measures'[Actual KPIs Switch]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Actual_KPIs_Switch], 0, 'dim_plant_hierarchy'[plant_cod], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Actual_KPIs_Switch] DESC, 'dim_plant_hierarchy'[plant_cod]
